issues.description: The UML and solution expect the Lecture attributes to be private, but the template currently declares two attributes as public (lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents). This inconsistency can confuse students about the intended visibility of attributes and whether they should keep fields public or follow the UML (use private fields with getters/setters).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template's attribute declarations match the UML and solution by changing the existing public fields to private (or removing them and adding private declarations for all five attributes). Optionally provide getter and setter method stubs in the template so students clearly see the intended encapsulation pattern.
